# IUpshiftVault
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/interfaces/upshift/IUpshiftVault.sol)

**Inherits:**
[IERC4626](../../contracts/misc/max-withdraw-executor.md#ierc4626)

**Title:**
IUpshiftVault

Interface for the Upshift ERC4626 vault with epoch-based asynchronous withdrawals


## Functions
### requestRedeem

Requests an asynchronous redemption of shares, scheduling a claim in a future epoch


```solidity
function requestRedeem(
    uint256 shares,
    address receiverAddr,
    address holderAddr
)
    external
    returns (uint256 assets, uint256 claimableEpoch);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`shares`|`uint256`|The amount of shares to redeem|
|`receiverAddr`|`address`|The address that will receive the assets on claim|
|`holderAddr`|`address`|The address whose shares are redeemed|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`assets`|`uint256`|The amount of assets that will be claimable|
|`claimableEpoch`|`uint256`|The epoch at which the assets become claimable|


### claim

Claims assets from a previously requested redemption scheduled for the given date


```solidity
function claim(uint256 year, uint256 month, uint256 day, address receiverAddr) external returns (uint256, uint256);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`year`|`uint256`|The year component of the scheduled withdrawal date|
|`month`|`uint256`|The month component of the scheduled withdrawal date|
|`day`|`uint256`|The day component of the scheduled withdrawal date|
|`receiverAddr`|`address`|The address receiving the claimed assets|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|The amount of assets claimed|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|The remaining or processed amount associated with the claim|


### getWithdrawalEpoch

Returns the current withdrawal epoch date and its claimable epoch


```solidity
function getWithdrawalEpoch()
    external
    view
    returns (uint256 year, uint256 month, uint256 day, uint256 claimableEpoch);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`year`|`uint256`|The year component of the current withdrawal date|
|`month`|`uint256`|The month component of the current withdrawal date|
|`day`|`uint256`|The day component of the current withdrawal date|
|`claimableEpoch`|`uint256`|The epoch at which withdrawals for this date become claimable|


### getClaimableAmountByReceiver

Returns the amount claimable by a receiver for a scheduled withdrawal date


```solidity
function getClaimableAmountByReceiver(
    uint256 year,
    uint256 month,
    uint256 day,
    address receiverAddr
)
    external
    view
    returns (uint256);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`year`|`uint256`|The year component of the withdrawal date|
|`month`|`uint256`|The month component of the withdrawal date|
|`day`|`uint256`|The day component of the withdrawal date|
|`receiverAddr`|`address`|The receiver whose claimable amount is queried|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|The claimable asset amount|


### getScheduledTransactionsByDate

Returns the scheduled transactions for a withdrawal date and their execution epoch


```solidity
function getScheduledTransactionsByDate(
    uint256 year,
    uint256 month,
    uint256 day
)
    external
    view
    returns (uint256 totalTransactions, uint256 executionEpoch);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`year`|`uint256`|The year component of the withdrawal date|
|`month`|`uint256`|The month component of the withdrawal date|
|`day`|`uint256`|The day component of the withdrawal date|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`totalTransactions`|`uint256`|The number of transactions scheduled for the date|
|`executionEpoch`|`uint256`|The epoch at which the scheduled transactions execute|


### processAllClaimsByDate

Processes outstanding claims for a withdrawal date, up to a limit


```solidity
function processAllClaimsByDate(uint256 year, uint256 month, uint256 day, uint256 limit) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`year`|`uint256`|The year component of the withdrawal date|
|`month`|`uint256`|The month component of the withdrawal date|
|`day`|`uint256`|The day component of the withdrawal date|
|`limit`|`uint256`|The maximum number of claims to process|


### lagDuration

Returns the lag duration between a redeem request and when it becomes claimable


```solidity
function lagDuration() external view returns (uint256);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|The lag duration in seconds|
